sections.Profile:
The "Goldeneye" pinball machine, manufactured by Sega in March 1996, is based on the James Bond film of the same name. Designed by Ward Pemberton, it features art by Jeff Busch and Paul Faris, and sound and music by Brian Schmidt.

- Manufacturer: Sega Pinball Inc. (US)
- Years made: 1996
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: DMD
- Players: 6
- Tags: James Bond, Licensed, Spy, 1990s, Solid State
